text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh! It's finally here, the moment 
has come!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I learned from my defeat and did 
everything humanly possible!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm not who I used to be! That's right, 
I'm—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes! Now, onward to glorious victory—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm okay! I just choked on my own spit! 
No need to worry!!
